actual_tracking_issue.title: [AutoPerf F014] User-target snapshot rejected: live user-ID semantics
actual_tracking_issue.body:
**Rejected/design-blocked: a simple per-send user-ID snapshot changes recipients. No shipping optimization or performance PR; not measured comparative no-gain.**

Actual public SendUsersAsync scans the live requested user IDs for each registered connection. A real JsonHubProtocol argument getter replaces eight requested user IDs in the same64-element array/List/read-only-wrapper backing input: one of eight actual transports receives a frame. Explicit copied-input controls passed to the unchanged owner deliver to all eight. Custom/derived ICollection.Contains dispatch also matters. These are native producer/input-semantics controls, not an implemented indexed owner or optimization red/green test; other compatible designs remain unverified.

User IDs come from actual public DefaultUserIdProvider.GetUserId on real connection principals during untimed setup, including absent-NameIdentifier nulls and multiple connections sharing a user. Case distinctions, duplicates, outside-group scope and per-connection send-once behavior are asserted. This warm-state boundary does not execute the internal protocol handshake. Unlike SendConnectionsAsync, this method has no16-target threshold.

[Immutable runnable project, complete evidence and limitations](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/6b6a46628c5c764acfca29eadf5a2a8e423ccd96/F014/README.md)

Different configured inputs and previous method timings are not before/after roles. Allocation is process-wide,not isolated owner/membership allocation. Empty-store4.76% CV and shared-user2.43% CV retained; an empty store executes no membership predicate.

Actual public user sends,real HubConnectionContext/JSON serialization,fixed256-byte synchronous per-connection transports. User-ID provider/principal/connection/input/group construction,network,handshake,stateful reconnect and typical production traffic are outside timing. Two real Pipe completion/backpressure/cancellation controls pass separately,untimed. Instrumented native misses yield1/128/2048 target values at1x1/8x16/32x64 dimensions with zero Count/indexer reads.
